name: ActionRow
summary: One next action in the Today list: a done ring, the title, a meta row (company, stage, time), the due label, a Snooze split button and an Open button. Done is a one-way action with Undo — the ring is a Button, never a Checkbox. The row owns its own controls and its done animation; the list (Today) owns the J/K/D/S/O shortcuts, the groups, the live region and the one Undo toast.

pattern.name: List row of actions (no single APG pattern; composes Button, Chip, Menu)

action.type: { id: string; title: string; company?: string; stage?: 'Lead' | 'Applied' | 'Screen' | 'Interview' | 'Offer'; time?: string; dueLabel: string }
action.intent: What the row shows. title is the imperative next step ('Email Priya'); company and stage become chips; time is a preformatted string ('10:00'); dueLabel is the preformatted due text ('Today', 'Mon', '2 days ago'). Date formatting and locale belong to the app, never to the row.

group.intent: Which Today group the row sits in. overdue colours the due label and the ring with status danger — only those two, never the whole row (backlog #2).

isDone.intent: Controlled done state, applied by the app the moment onDone fires (backlog #4). true runs the done moment (ring fills, tick draws, title strikes, row collapses) and makes the collapsed row inert; false again — Undo — restores the row in place.

onDone.intent: The done ring was pressed. The app marks the action done at once, shows the one Undo toast and updates the live region ('Done. 3 due today.'); the row does none of that.

onSnooze.intent: A snooze preset was chosen. The Snooze button itself applies the default '+3d' (backlog #5); the menu offers Tomorrow / In 3 days / Monday / Pick a date… — 'pick' asks the app to open its date picker.

onOpen.intent: The Open button was pressed: navigate to the action's application card.

keyboard.action: Moves through the row's controls in reading order: done ring → Snooze → Snooze options → Open. Each is a real Button.
Marks done (onDone). One-way: the ring is a Button with aria-label 'Mark done: {title}', not a checkbox — it does not toggle back, Undo lives in the toast and in the list.
Applies the default preset (+3d). The chevron beside it opens the preset Menu; inside it the Menu's own keys apply (arrows, Enter, Escape closes and returns focus to the chevron).

keyboard.key: J / K · D · S · O / Enter
keyboard.action: List-level, not the row's: the Today list moves focus between rows with J/K (onto the row's first control) and maps D → onDone, S → opens this row's snooze menu, O/Enter → onOpen for the row that has focus within. The row only exposes the handlers; it never listens for letters, so no shortcut can fire inside an input (backlog #3).

a11y.name: The row is a listitem with no name of its own; each control is named for the action: 'Mark done: Email Priya', 'Snooze: Email Priya' (default +3 days), 'Snooze options: Email Priya', 'Open: Email Priya'. The title is visible text inside the row, so a screen reader reads title → chips → due → the four buttons.
a11y.announcements: Nothing is announced by the row itself. Done is confirmed by the list's live region ('Done. 3 due today.') and the Undo toast (role=status), per the Toast and Chip rules — one announcement per change. Overdue is in the due label's text ('2 days ago'), not only its colour. Done is in the ring's pressed state and the struck title; a collapsed done row is inert and aria-hidden until the app removes or restores it.
a11y.targetSize: Every control is ≥ 44 px (size.target.touch): the done target is 44 px around a 24 px ring, Snooze and Open are size lg. Row min-height 56 px on desktop.

rules: The done ring is a Button, never a Checkbox: done is a one-way action with an Undo, and a checkbox promises a toggle (Checkbox spec, rule 1). aria-label 'Mark done: {title}'; while isDone it is aria-pressed="true" so the state is exposed, not just drawn.

Done is applied immediately and confirmed later (backlog #4): the app flips isDone on onDone, shows the one Undo toast and writes the live region; the row only animates. Undo = isDone back to false, and the row expands in place — nothing is re-created, focus is not lost.

The done moment (motion spec 1, 320 ms): ring scales to 0.9 (duration.fast), fills action.primary and the tick draws (duration.normal), title turns subtle with a line-through growing left→right (duration.normal), then the row collapses via grid-template-rows 1fr→0fr (duration.fast) — the only layout animation allowed. Transform and opacity otherwise. Interruptible: Undo mid-animation reverses from wherever it is. Reduced motion: the generated tokens zero the durations, so everything lands at once; no translate larger than 4 px exists in the row.

Overdue is never colour-only and never whole-row: the due label says so in words ('2 days ago') and only the label and the ring take status danger (backlog #2). The title, chips and buttons stay neutral.

Snooze is a split button, a composition not a component (Menu spec, rule 2): a Button applying the default +3d next to an icon-only Button that opens the preset Menu. The two are one role="group" named 'Snooze: {title}'. 'Pick a date…' delegates to the app's date picker; the row never renders one.

Letter shortcuts belong to the list. The row never adds a keydown listener for J/K/D/S/O: a letter handler on a row would fire inside quick-add's input when the row has focus within, and the list already knows which row is current. The row exposes onDone / onSnooze / onOpen and stable accessible names; the list drives them.
focus is a browser state: the row's outline (border.width.focus, border.focus, inset) is :focus-within, not a prop. The handoff's `focused` prop is replaced by this (ADR-033).
Chips carry no status colour (Chip spec, rule 3): company is a property chip, stage a static stage chip. Stage cycling is StageChip's job (backlog #10, P1), not the row's.
The row formats nothing: dueLabel and time arrive as strings. Relative dates, locale, 12/24 h are the app's, so the same row is right in English and Ukrainian.
Phone: the meta row wraps under the title and the due label joins it; the buttons keep 44 px. Nothing is hidden behind a swipe without a visible button equivalent (handoff gesture rule).

examples.title: A row in the Today group
examples.code: <ActionRow action={{ id: 'a1', title: 'Email Priya', company: 'Orbit', stage: 'Interview', time: '10:00', dueLabel: 'Today' }} group="today" isDone={done.has('a1')} onDone={markDone} onSnooze={snooze} onOpen={open} />

examples.title: Overdue: only the label and the ring go danger
examples.code: <ActionRow action={{ id: 'a2', title: 'Follow up with Lumen Health', company: 'Lumen Health', stage: 'Applied', dueLabel: '2 days ago' }} group="overdue" onDone={markDone} onSnooze={snooze} onOpen={open} />

examples.title: The list owns the toast and the undo
examples.code: const markDone = (a) => { setDone((s) => new Set(s).add(a.id)); setToast({ text: `Done: ${a.title}`, undo: () => setDone((s) => { const n = new Set(s); n.delete(a.id); return n; }) }); };
